title: 第一卷 第11章 赌场风云！
slug: 满门遗孀花甲老汉粮肉满仓

第(1/3)页

女捕快冷声喝问，场中一静。

上官飞燕反应极快，立马扑到林骁身边，哭喊道：“官差大人，这帮人要抢我们的钱，还出言羞辱，我和爷爷相依为命，爷爷都八十了，好不容易打到猎，还要受他们欺负……您可要替我们做主啊！”

她抱着林骁哭得梨花带雨，林骁险些没忍住笑。

这小妮子，演得倒像。

他也配合地佝偻起背，咳了两声，做出老迈模样。

女捕快看向熊天几人，目光更冷：“光天化日，朗朗乾坤，竟敢当街强抢？”

熊天连忙喊冤：“是他们先动的手，我兄弟的手都被砍伤了！”

那瘦子捂着血流不止的手臂，哀声道：“是啊官差大人，您看我这手……”

“你若不强取豪夺，人家会动手？”女捕快声音清朗，“难不成只许你们抢，不许百姓反抗？”

这话让林骁对这女捕快多了几分好感，他忙附和：“官差大人说得是，小老儿是被逼无奈啊……”

熊天见势不妙，知道今日讨不到好，咬牙道：“好好好，我们走！”

他瞪了林骁一眼，带着手下悻悻离开。

那瘦子边走边嚎，血滴滴答答洒了一路。

女捕快这才转身，对林骁道：“老伯，没受惊吧？”

“不碍事，多谢官差大人解围。”林骁拱手，“敢问大人尊姓大名？”

“冷岳。”女捕快抱拳，“保护百姓安危，是分内之事。”

“说得好！”上官飞燕鼓掌。

冷岳笑了笑，又叮嘱几句，这才离去。

等她走远，林骁收起摊子，对上官飞燕笑道：“刚才演得挺像。”

“我可没演。”上官飞燕哼了一声，眼中却带着得意。

两人收拾好，林骁驾着马车，在城里寻了家干净馆子。

“鸭血粉丝汤，两碗。”林骁坐下，又点了盘酱牛肉、一碟青菜。

热腾腾的粉丝汤端上来，汤色乳白，鸭血嫩滑，香气扑鼻。

上官飞燕饿了一上午，埋头猛吃，烫得直哈气也舍不得停。

林骁吃得慢些，目光不时扫过街面。

一碗汤下肚，上官飞燕满足地叹气，竟打了个嗝。

她脸一红，忙捂住嘴，小声道：“我们……回去吗？”

“好不容易来一趟，多逛逛。”林骁付了钱，起身道，“走，买点东西。”

“买什么？”

“布。”

布庄离得不远，门面不大，但里头料子齐全。

从粗麻布到细棉布，再到绫罗绸缎，一匹匹码得整齐。

老板娘是个三十来岁的女子，身段丰腴，面容姣好，见客人进门，笑着迎上：“二位客官，想扯什么布？”

“拿两匹上好青绫，再挑一匹熟缎。”林骁开口说道。

老板娘一怔，仔细打量两人。

老头衣着朴素，小姑娘倒是眉清目秀，但也不像富贵人家。

青绫和熟缎都不便宜，寻常百姓哪舍得买？

“客官当真要这么多？”她试探道。

“当真。”林骁点头，“家里人多，你算算账。”

老板娘将信将疑，取了布匹，拨着算盘：“青绫一匹八两，两匹一十六两，熟缎一匹一十四两，共计三十两。”

上官飞燕在一旁听得咋舌，悄悄扯林骁袖子：“太贵啦……”

林骁面不改色，掏出十两银子放在柜上：“掌柜的先准备着，我等会儿来取，到时结清余款。”

老板娘见真金白银，立马笑开了花：“好好好，我给您包好！”

出了布庄，上官飞燕忍不住道：“老头，咱们一共才赚五十两，你买布就花三十两，太浪费了……”

“不浪费，你们身上那些衣服，早该换了。”林骁大方表示。

上官飞燕低头，扯了扯洗得发白的衣角，小声道：“洗洗还能穿……”

“穿新的。”林骁拍拍她头，跳上马车，“走，去东市。”

东市是买卖牲畜家禽的地方。

一进去，鸡鸣鸭叫混成一片，气味也冲。

可仔细看，那些鸡鸭鹅都蔫头耷脑，羽毛暗淡，显然是饿的。

荒年人都吃不饱，哪有余粮喂它们？

林骁在几个摊子前转了转，停在一处卖鹅的摊前。

竹笼里关着二十来只大白鹅，虽瘦，但羽毛还算厚实。

The female catcher asked coldly, and there was silence in the place.

Shangguan Feiyan reacted very quickly and immediately rushed to Lin Xiao's side, crying: "Sir, these people want to rob us of our money, and they also use words to humiliate us. Grandpa and I depend on each other. Grandpa is already eighty. He finally hunted and was bullied by them... You have to make the decision for us!"

She hugged Lin Xiao and cried so hard that Lin Xiao could hardly hold back his laughter.

This little girl acts like a charm.

He also hunched his back in cooperation, coughed twice, and looked old.

The female catcher looked at Xiong Tian and the others, her eyes even colder: "How dare you rob someone in the street in broad daylight?"

Xiong Tian quickly cried out: "They were the ones who struck first, and my brother's hand was cut!"

The thin man covered his bleeding arm and wailed, "Yes, Lord Official, look at my hands..."

"If you don't take it by force, others will do it?" The female detective's voice was clear, "Is it possible that we only allow you to rob, and the people are not allowed to resist?"

These words made Lin Xiao feel more fond of the female detective, and he quickly agreed: "The official officer is right, the little old man is forced to have no choice..."

Seeing that the situation was not good, Xiong Tian knew that he would not get any favors today, so he gritted his teeth and said: "Okay, okay, let's go!"

He glared at Lin Xiao and left angrily with his men.

The thin man howled as he walked, and blood dripped all the way.

The female detective then turned around and said to Lin Xiao: "Old man, are you not scared?"

"It's okay. Thank you, Lord Official, for rescuing the siege." Lin Xiao held his hand, "May I ask your surname?"

"Leng Yue." The female catcher clasped her fists, "It is our duty to protect the safety of the people."

"Well said!" Shangguan Feiyan applauded.

Leng Yue smiled, gave a few more instructions, and then left.

When she walked away, Lin Xiao put away the stall, smiled at Shangguan Feiyan and said, "It looked very similar to her just now."

"I didn't act." Shangguan Feiyan snorted, but there was pride in his eyes.

After the two of them packed up, Lin Xiao drove the carriage and found a clean restaurant in the city.

"Duck blood vermicelli soup, two bowls." Lin Xiao sat down and ordered another plate of beef with soy sauce and a plate of green vegetables.

The hot vermicelli soup was served. The soup was milky white, tender and smooth with duck blood, and fragrant.

Shangguan Feiyan was hungry all morning and ate hard. She was so hot that she couldn't stop breathing.

Lin Xiao ate more slowly, his eyes scanning the street from time to time.

After finishing the bowl of soup, Shangguan Feiyan sighed contentedly and actually burped.

She blushed, covered her mouth and whispered: "Shall we... go back?"

"It's hard to come here and take a look around." Lin Xiao paid the money, stood up and said, "Let's go and buy something."

"What to buy?"

"Bu."

Cloth Shop is not far away. It doesn't have a big appearance, but it has a complete range of materials.

From burlap to fine cotton, to silk and satin, each piece is neatly coded.

The landlady is a woman in her thirties, with a plump figure and a pretty face. When she sees the guests coming in, she greets them with a smile: "Two guests, what do you want to pull?"

"Take two pieces of fine green silk and choose one piece of ripe satin." Lin Xiao said.

The landlady was startled and looked at the two of them carefully.

The old man was dressed simply, and the little girl was pretty, but she didn't look like someone from a wealthy family.

Both green silk and satin are not cheap, so how can ordinary people afford to buy them?

"Does the guest really want so much?" she asked tentatively.

"Seriously." Lin Xiao nodded, "There are many people in the family, so you can settle the score."

The landlady was doubtful, so she took the piece of cloth and dialed the abacus: "One piece of green silk is eighty taels, two pieces are one sixteen taels, and one piece of ripe satin is one fourteen taels, a total of thirty taels."

Shangguan Feiyan was stunned when he heard this, and quietly tugged on Lin Xiao's sleeve: "It's too expensive..."

Lin Xiao's expression didn't change, he took out ten taels of silver and put it on the cabinet: "The shopkeeper will prepare it first. I will pick it up later and settle the balance then."

When the lady boss saw the real money, she immediately burst into laughter: "Okay, okay, I'll wrap it up for you!"

After leaving the cloth shop, Shangguan Feiyan couldn't help but said: "Old man, we only earned fifty taels in total, and you only spent thirty taels on cloth. It's such a waste..."

"Don't waste it. Those clothes you are wearing should have been changed long ago." Lin Xiao said generously.

Shangguan Feiyan lowered her head, tugged at the corner of her clothes that had turned white after washing, and whispered: "You can still wear it after washing..."

"Wear new ones." Lin Xiao patted her head and jumped on the carriage, "Let's go to Dongshi."

The East Market is a place where livestock and poultry are bought and sold.

As soon as we entered, the crowing of chickens and ducks merged into one, and the smell was also overwhelming.

But if you look carefully, you can see that the chickens, ducks and geese are all wilted and have dull feathers. They are obviously hungry.

In years of famine, when people don’t have enough to eat, how can there be any food left to feed them?

Lin Xiao walked around several stalls and stopped in front of a stall selling geese.

There are about twenty big white geese in the bamboo cage. Although they are thin, their feathers are still thick.
